metadata.title: Platform-Specific AI Search Optimization (Lite)
metadata.description: Platform-specific AI search optimization for all ten documented AI answer platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews and Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Qwen, Meta AI, Microsoft Copilot, Apple Intelligence), registry-bound, reported as a per-platform checklist with no score. Lite edition.
metadata.author: BIQDADDY

configuration.purpose: Audit and optimize a website for each AI answer platform individually: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Qwen, Meta AI, Microsoft Copilot and Apple Intelligence. Every platform is a checklist, never a number.

workflow.core_insight: Domains cited by BOTH ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews for the same query are the exception rather than the rule. Each AI search platform uses different indexes, ranking logic, and source preferences. Platform-specific optimization is not optional.
workflow.method: Walk the checklist for each platform and mark every item ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, or ตรวจไม่ได้. There is no point matrix, report the checklist result and the gaps it exposes.
workflow.marking_rule: ยังไม่มี ใช้ได้ต่อเมื่อไปดูมาแล้วและยืนยันว่าไม่มีจริง ถ้ายังไม่ได้เห็นหลักฐานให้ลงว่า ตรวจไม่ได้ พร้อมบอกว่าขาดอะไร ห้ามลงว่า ยังไม่มี และถึงจะมีหลายข้อที่ ตรวจไม่ได้ ก็ยังต้องส่งผลของข้อที่เหลือ ห้ามยกเลิกทั้งงาน

query_eligibility_gate.position: Runs BEFORE any page is scored against any platform checklist. It is a gate on the QUERY SET, not a scoring criterion on a page.

step_1_query_mode_routing.rule: Build the AI-visibility target list from search MODE, not from topic alone.
step_1_query_mode_routing.not_targets: Queries where the user already knows the destination, and queries that want one exact fact. These are served by the classic index path, so effort on them belongs in classic organic.
step_1_query_mode_routing.targets: The queries a person would otherwise resolve over several successive refinements. The conversational answer surfaces were designed to absorb this mode.
step_1_query_mode_routing.test: Would a human realistically need three or more refining searches to finish this task? Multi-constraint, comparison, and which-should-I queries qualify. Single-fact and navigational queries do not.
step_1_query_mode_routing.routing: Drop the queries that are not AI-visibility targets and record each one as routed to classic organic. Never drop them silently.

observed_behaviours: The generative answer layer withholds a response entirely for topics where reliable data is scarce.
It refuses generation for queries signalling a vulnerable user situation.
It attaches an explicit verify-elsewhere disclaimer on YMYL results.

buckets.generation_suppressed: Scarce reliable data, or a vulnerable user situation. AI-answer opportunity is zero. Do NOT score pages for these queries; spend the effort on classic organic and say so in the report.
buckets.disclaimer_attached: YMYL queries answered with a verify-elsewhere disclaimer. Score them, with consensus alignment and citable authority dominating the emphasis.
buckets.normal: Everything the surface answers without suppression or an attached disclaimer. Score on the full platform checklists.

step_2_answer_suppression_classes.score_only: Score pages only for the disclaimer_attached and normal buckets.
step_2_answer_suppression_classes.defer: Whether a topic is YMYL belongs to seo-content-audit-lite; read that classification rather than making one. With no such reading available, label the bucketing as provisional and awaiting confirmation, never as fact.

procedure: Collect the client candidate query set before opening any platform checklist.
Apply query mode routing first and drop the non-targets, recording each as routed to classic organic.
Apply the answer-suppression classes to what remains and assign each query to one of the three buckets.
Score pages only for the disclaimer_attached and normal buckets.
Show the bucket counts and the classic-organic routing list in the report.
query_eligibility_gate.failure_mode: Without this gate the skill scores every page on the same checklist regardless of whether an AI answer can ever appear for that query, and hands the client a full remediation plan for query sets where the surface is designed never to generate.
query_eligibility_gate.missing_query_set: If the client has supplied no query set, ask for one. If it still does not arrive, infer candidate queries from the page content, continue the run, and label the bucketing as not yet confirmed against real queries. Never abandon the whole job over this step.

platform_1_google_aio.title: Google AI Overviews (AIO)
how_it_selects: Most AIO citations come from pages already ranking near the top of organic results
A meaningful share of citations still comes from pages ranking lower, so AIO applies its own selection logic on top of rank
Strongly favors clean structure, direct answers, and scannable formatting
Featured snippet optimization overlaps substantially with AIO optimization
checklist: Question-Based Headings: H2/H3 phrased as questions matching real user queries
Direct Answer in First Paragraph: 1-2 sentence answer immediately after each question heading
Tables and Structured Comparisons: Convert comparison/pricing/spec data into HTML tables
Ordered and Unordered Lists: Step-by-step as ordered, features as unordered
FAQ Sections: real customer questions with H3 headings
Definitions and Glossary Boxes: Clear definitions for industry terms
Statistics with Sources: Specific numbers with attribution
Publication Date: Visible publish and last-updated dates
Author Byline: Name with credentials, linked author page
Page Depth: reachable in a few clicks from the homepage
platform_1_google_aio.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.
registry_checklist: Ranks in Google top 10 for the target query

platform_2_chatgpt.title: ChatGPT Web Search
how_it_selects: Uses OpenAI's own search index built by OAI-SearchBot (Bing now plays only a secondary role) , allowing OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt matters more than Bing SEO
Top citation sources: Wikipedia (47.9%), Reddit (11.3%), YouTube, major news
Heavily weights entity recognition (Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crunchbase)
Prefers authoritative, well-established sources
Longer, comprehensive articles cited more often
checklist: Wikipedia Presence: Check/create article if notable
Wikidata Entity: Verify/create with key properties
Bing Webmaster Tools: Register, submit sitemap, fix errors
Bing Index Coverage: Verify key pages indexed via site:domain.com on Bing
Reddit Authority: Check brand mentions and participation
YouTube Presence: Channel with relevant content
Authoritative Backlinks: .edu, .gov, major publications
Entity Consistency: Same info across Wikipedia, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, website
Comprehensive Content: 2000+ words with thorough coverage
Clear Attribution: About sections, company descriptions, founding stories
platform_2_chatgpt.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.
registry_checklist: H1 and first visible text carry the answer

platform_3_perplexity.title: Perplexity AI
how_it_selects: Top citation: Reddit (46.7%), Wikipedia, YouTube, major publications
Heaviest emphasis on community validation of all AI platforms
Strongly favors discussion threads with multiple participants
Prefers recent content , publication date is strong ranking signal
Cites 5-15 sources per answer , more opportunity for mid-authority sites
checklist: Active Reddit Presence: Authentic participation in relevant subreddits
Reddit AMAs and Threads: Detailed discussion threads and Q&As
Forum/Community Presence: Hacker News, Stack Overflow, Quora, niche forums
Discussion-Friendly Content: Opinion pieces, research, original data
Freshness Signals: Clear dates, regular updates
Multiple Source Validation: Claims supported by other sources
YouTube Video Content: Videos Perplexity can reference
Direct, Quotable Passages: Standalone paragraphs with clear points
Original Data and Research: Surveys, benchmarks, case studies
Perplexity Pages: Check if Perplexity has curated a Page about topic/brand
platform_3_perplexity.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.

platform_4_gemini.title: Google Gemini
how_it_selects: Uses Google's search index plus strong weighting toward Google-owned properties
YouTube content weighted significantly more than standard Google Search
Google Business Profile data directly accessible
Uses Google Knowledge Graph directly
Structured data consumed directly for entity understanding
Multi-modal: can reference images, videos, and text together
checklist: Google Knowledge Panel: Check/claim through GBP or structured data
Google Business Profile: Complete all fields (completeness measured by seo-social-profile; reuse that verdict, see workflow.gbp_completeness_verification)
YouTube Strategy: Content for every key topic with chapters
YouTube Chapters and Timestamps: For Gemini to reference segments
Google Merchant Center: Products registered (e-commerce)
Structured Data (Schema.org): Comprehensive markup
Google Sites Ecosystem: Scholar, News, Maps presence
Image Optimization: Descriptive alt text, structured filenames
Google E-E-A-T Signals: Author pages, about pages, editorial policies
Chrome Web Store / Workspace Marketplace: Presence (software companies)
platform_4_gemini.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.

platform_5_bing_copilot.title: Bing Copilot
how_it_selects: Uses Bing's search index
Supports IndexNow protocol for near-instant indexing
Cites fewer sources per answer (3-5) but more prominent attribution
Microsoft ecosystem integration: LinkedIn, GitHub, Microsoft Learn
Prefers structured markup and fast load times
checklist: Bing Webmaster Tools: Register, verify, submit sitemap
IndexNow Implementation: Real-time content change notification
LinkedIn Company Page: Complete with accurate description and posts
GitHub Presence: Active repos (tech companies)
Microsoft Learn / Documentation: Compatible docs (if relevant)
Bing Places for Business: Complete all fields (local)
Clear Meta Descriptions: Bing weights these more than Google
Social Signals: Active social media presence
Exact-Match Keywords: Bing is more literal about keyword matching
Fast Page Load: Target sub-2-second load time
platform_5_bing_copilot.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.

platform_6_claude.title: Claude (Anthropic)
how_it_selects: Claude does not browse by default; with web search on it retrieves through Claude-SearchBot's index and live Claude-User fetches, with Brave Search officially named as the web search subprocessor
Anthropic documents meta robots noindex as removing a page from Claude web search results; blocking ClaudeBot (training) does not remove search visibility
Answers favour verifiable, specific statements with attribution and a clean logical document structure
Citations API returns the exact passages used, so quotable standalone paragraphs are lifted verbatim
checklist: Crawler access: Claude-SearchBot and Claude-User allowed; ClaudeBot is a separate training decision
A short definitional answer block under the H1 and several quotable standalone paragraphs
Numeric facts (numbers, prices, percentages) present in the passages that should be cited
Factual, non-promotional wording with few superlatives
One H1 and no skipped heading levels
Author byline with credentials in JSON-LD or a visible byline
No nosnippet or restrictive max-snippet, page indexable
llms.txt present (hygiene, low weight)
platform_6_claude.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.

platform_7_deepseek.title: DeepSeek
how_it_selects: DeepSeek's privacy policy states search is provided through third-party APIs (Bing was named in the 2025 text, no provider in the 2026 text) and no crawler user agent is published
Reasoning models follow document structure and technical precision: server-rendered text, comparison tables and a logical heading order are what survive retrieval
DeepSeek referral traffic outside China is negligible in 2026 studies; treat readiness here as a hedge, not a growth channel
checklist: Server-side rendered text readable without JavaScript
Comparison tables with header cells for specs and prices
Clean H1 to H3 hierarchy
Presence on developer and open-source hubs (GitHub, docs, Stack Overflow, Hugging Face; evidence from aiso-brand-mentions-lite)
Numeric precision: figures, units and dates per claim
Crawler access: could not verify (no documented user agent); report it that way
platform_7_deepseek.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.
platform_7_deepseek.crawler_access_rule: No documented crawler: report crawler access as ตรวจไม่ได้ and never as a failed item.

platform_8_grok.title: Grok (xAI)
how_it_selects: Two retrieval tools: x_search over X posts and web_search over the open web; roughly 45 percent of citations in 2026 samples are X posts and verified accounts are cited far more often
xAI publishes no crawler user agent; fetches are observed with browser user agents, and GrokAgent (hosted browser agent) signs requests with Web Bot Auth
Lowest organic top-10 overlap of the major engines, so classic rankings buy little here; real-time social presence does
checklist: Active, verified X account posting on the topic (evidence from aiso-brand-mentions-lite)
Brand sentiment on X sampled from recent posts (evidence from aiso-brand-mentions-lite)
X profile linked from the site through sameAs
twitter:card and twitter:site tags on every page
Recent dateModified on the pages that should be cited
Complete Open Graph tags
Crawler access: could not verify; report it that way
platform_8_grok.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.
registry_checklist: X profile linked from the site
platform_8_grok.crawler_access_rule: No documented crawler: report crawler access as ตรวจไม่ได้ and never as a failed item.

platform_9_qwen.title: Qwen (Alibaba Cloud)
how_it_selects: Qwen chat and Tongyi apps retrieve through Alibaba search infrastructure (Shenma and Quark spiders observed as Yisouspider); Alibaba documents a paid web search tool for API users and no crawler for site owners
Bilingual and Chinese content, hreflang alternates and consistent language declarations drive retrieval; spec and price tables are extracted well
Qwen-User, QwenBot and TongyiBot are community-observed tokens with no verification method
checklist: Bilingual (TH and EN, or CN) pages for the core services (evidence: site crawl)
hreflang alternates on every localised page
html lang agrees with og:locale
Spec and price comparison tables
Server-rendered text
Crawler access: could not verify; report it that way
platform_9_qwen.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.
platform_9_qwen.crawler_access_rule: No documented crawler: report crawler access as ตรวจไม่ได้ and never as a failed item.

platform_10_meta_ai.title: Meta AI
how_it_selects: Meta AI answers in WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and meta.ai cite through meta-webindexer's index and show Bing and Google results as Sources
Every Meta surface reads Open Graph tags for shared links; og:locale must match the content language
meta-externalagent is the training crawler and meta-externalfetcher the user fetcher that may bypass robots.txt; only meta-webindexer decides citation
checklist: robots.txt allows meta-webindexer explicitly
og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url on every page
Facebook and Instagram profiles linked through sameAs and complete (evidence from the client profile or a user-supplied profile check)
og:locale consistent with html lang
Indexed in Bing (evidence)
platform_10_meta_ai.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.

platform_11_apple_intelligence.title: Apple Intelligence (Siri, Spotlight, Safari)
how_it_selects: Applebot indexes for Spotlight, Siri and Safari; Apple documents that world-knowledge answers may include links to the sources used
Applebot-Extended does not crawl: it only opts a site out of training Apple foundation models, and nosnippet opts a page out of use as answer context
Siri favours concise factual answers; ChatGPT and Gemini integrations answer open-ended questions
checklist: Applebot allowed; nosnippet absent on pages that should be cited
FAQ content or FAQPage markup with direct answers
Several quotable standalone passages
speakable markup on answer sections
Question-phrased headings for voice queries
platform_11_apple_intelligence.marking: Each item: ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้. No points.

universal_actions: Comprehensive, well-structured content with clear headings
Fast page load and clean HTML
Author pages with credentials and sameAs links
Regular content updates with visible dates
Allow every documented search crawler (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, meta-webindexer, Applebot, Googlebot, bingbot) and decide training crawlers separately

sections: Query Eligibility Gate (bucket counts plus the queries routed to classic organic)
Platform checklist table: 11 cards, per card the counts of ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี, ตรวจไม่ได้ and the crawler evidence tier; no score
Platform details with per-card checklist, gaps and actions
Prioritized action plan: quick wins, medium term, strategic
Card feed: the checklist JSON for build_summary.py --checklist and the platforms block of summary.json

registry_binding.rule: Eleven cards for ten platforms: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Qwen, Meta AI, Microsoft Copilot, Apple Intelligence. Crawler tokens, evidence tiers and checklist items come from the registry; when this file and the registry disagree the registry wins.
registry_binding.no_score: Lite edition: every platform is a checklist answered ผ่าน, บางส่วน, ยังไม่มี or ตรวจไม่ได้. There is no per-platform number, no site number and no band. Count the items per state and report the counts.
registry_binding.unverifiable_rule: When the vendor publishes no crawler documentation (Grok, DeepSeek) or only community-observed tokens (Qwen), crawler access is ตรวจไม่ได้ on that card and is excluded from the counts.
registry_binding.evidence_from_other_skills: Off-site facts come from their owning skills: Wikidata, Knowledge Panel, Reddit, YouTube, X activity and tech-hub presence from aiso-brand-mentions-lite; profile completeness from the client profile; Google top 10 and Bing index from the user (Search Console, site: search). A missing fact is ตรวจไม่ได้.
registry_binding.llms_txt: llms.txt is a hygiene item on every card: 2025 and 2026 measurements found no major platform reading it. Keep generating it through aiso-llmstxt-lite; never present it as the reason a card passes or fails.
registry_binding.card_feed: Write the checklist JSON that build_summary.py --checklist reads: {"platforms": [{"id", "label", "status" (ok, warning, critical, info), "crawler_access" (allowed, blocked, partial, unverifiable, not_checked), "note"}], "dimensions": [{"key": "platform_checklist", "label", "passed", "total"}]}
